content:
Apple just weeks after announcing a price increase for Apple Music monthly fees, today (16th) announced that Apple TV+ monthly fees will also be raised. Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that the Apple TV+ monthly fee will increase from US$12.99 (approximately HK$117) to US$14.99 (approximately HK$117).

The Apple One Individual plan monthly fee will also be raised simultaneously.

Apple TV+ and Apple One Price Adjustments

Price increase details are as follows:

  • Apple TV+ (monthly): US$14.99 (original price US$12.99)
  • Apple TV+ (annual): US$119 (original price US$99)
  • Apple One Individual: US$21.95 (original price US$19.95)

Other Apple One plan prices remain unchanged. When Apple raised Apple Music monthly fees last month, it also simultaneously raised Apple One Family and Apple One Premier monthly fees, but at that time did not adjust the Individual plan price.

New rates apply immediately to new subscribers. Apple stated that existing subscribers will be notified of the price adjustment approximately one month before the new rates take effect.

Apple last adjusted Apple TV+ monthly fees in August last year, when the monthly fee was raised from US$9.99 to US$12.99; that price increase did not adjust annual plan or Apple One bundle prices.

Apple has significantly expanded the Apple TV+ content lineup over the past year. In October last year, Apple announced it had become the exclusive broadcast partner for Formula 1 (F1) in the United States; F1 race live broadcasts are now included in standard Apple TV+ subscriptions at no additional charge.

Earlier this year, Apple also added Major League Soccer (MLS) live match broadcasts to the Apple TV+ platform, likewise at no additional charge. Previously, watching MLS matches required a separate MLS Season Pass subscription.

Apple has also benefited from the recent successful launches of several shows, such as the fourth season of "Ted Lasso." Apple TV+ also premieres the second season of "Dark Matter" today, while the sixth season of "Slow Horses" is scheduled to premiere on September 16.

What do you think of the new Apple TV+ monthly fee? At US$14.99 per month, is Apple TV+ content worth the price? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
